title: Calculus recall
learner: Returning learners with prior calculus exposure who need to reconnect algebraic procedures to rates, local behavior, and accumulated change.

include: Derivative meaning, polynomial rules, and rates
Product, quotient, chain, and elementary rules
Integrals, signed accumulation, and the fundamental theorem
exclude: A full first-time calculus course or formal epsilon-delta proofs
Advanced integration techniques, improper integrals, infinite series, multivariable calculus
Unspecified angle modes, domain assumptions, or calculator approximations presented as proof

routes.quick: Five diagnostic probes route to individual lessons. Use Quick recall, then each independent lesson checkpoint and the mixed recall.
routes.full: Follow limits, derivative meaning, composite rules, accumulation, and initial conditions. Predict in each activity and save explanations in notes.

escalation.text: For first-time instruction, use the linked free Calculus Volume 1 sections and the CSC 208 course destination. CSC 209 extends beyond this refresher. Algebra, function, trig, and logarithm refreshers supply available prerequisite support.

overlap: MTH 215 m02-l04 and F03 teach average rates and finite difference quotients, not calculus limits.
F02 factoring and canceled-domain restrictions support removable limits.
F04 radians and F05 logarithm domains supply shared conventions.
reuse.implementation: Wrap the committed mth-average-rate formula/reverse and mth-difference-quotient quadratic/reciprocal families under F08 identities, keeping their finite-quotient explanations. Reuse exact rational/polynomial graders and existing progress/notes/backup; no parser or storage redesign.

assessment.checkpoints: Four critical multipart questions per lesson cover its full stated objective; at most eight fields per question.
assessment.mixed: Four questions: combined limits/derivative with field-specific routes, elementary/chain rules, signed accumulation, and initial conditions. Lesson checkpoints cover remaining structures.
assessment.evidence: Visits, confidence, assisted practice, diagnostic and activities do not establish independent evidence. F08 checkpoints and mixed recall have separate versioned evidence.

sharedCapabilities.integration: One strict union member and reader dispatch to a scoped keyboard-accessible component, pure models, SVGs and equivalent tables.

verification: Check all structures over at least100seeds against independent symbolic coefficients, direct substitutions, analytic one-sided signs, and numeric finite differences where appropriate.
Independently integrate by power moments and compare derivative/antiderivative round trips; check signed versus absolute accumulation and all initial conditions.
Check equivalent polynomial and fractional answers; retain original domains, h≠0, zero-width bounds, nonzero substitution slopes and radian conventions; render all KaTeX.
Exercise every guided/activity route plus full diagnostic, checkpoint, mixed recall, notes/resume/backup; keyboard, desktop/mobile, Axe; full tests, lint, types, production build.
Release as preview only after verification; human review remains pending. Finish F08 before detailed planning of F09.
